title: Proprietary on-chain Fear & Greed score (0-100) from own Bitcoin Core node. Aggr
description: Proprietary on-chain Fear & Greed score (0-100) from own Bitcoin Core node. Aggregates 4 components: Coin Days Destroyed (smart-money flow), mempool pressure (sat/vB urgency), hashrate trend (miner sentiment), whale balance changes. Updated every 10min. AI agent API for on-chain sentiment regime — independent signal vs price-derived indicators. Informational research data only.
